versions.changelog:
interop-forge 0.1.1

- Added explicit package manager detection and compatibility: pnpm, yarn berry, and npm now all supported.
- Updated planning protocol and behavior to auto-detect and adapt workspace/command generation to the user’s package manager.
- Clarified default to pnpm but respect for user’s existing lockfiles or explicit package manager requests.
- Documentation improved to reflect all package manager support and corresponding workspace config conventions.

Interop Forge — initial release

- Provides integration architecture guidance for multi-app monorepos, including shared contracts, OpenAPI-first design, cross-app authentication, generated SDKs, and MCP server scaffolding.
- Enforces a mandatory planning protocol before any integration work begins, reducing the risk of type mismatches or circular dependencies.
- Supports detection and adaptation to common monorepo tools such as Turborepo, Nx, Yarn, and pnpm workspaces.
- Outlines recommended monorepo structure and includes sample configuration and setup for shared TypeScript packages and contract schemas.
- Clearly defines credential handling policy: only references environment variables in generated code, never accesses or modifies credentials directly.
